name: Pilot Hammerfoot
summary: At North Gate Outpost, Pilot Hammerfoot watches the pass and searches for a missing fellow pilot. The Siege Brigade’s engines guard the route, but the mountain hills are dangerous.

sections.title: Eyes in the Mountains
sections.body: At North Gate Outpost, Pilot Hammerfoot watches the passes between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. He guards Ironforge’s siege engines for the Siege Brigade. The rough mountain ground makes those engines dangerous to drive. Now one pilot is missing, and savage beasts roam the nearby hills. Finding him matters.

sections.title: Avenging a Comrade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot was close friends with Pilot Mori Hildelve, another siege engine pilot. They searched for rare ore when Hildelve broke his engine on a steep hill and went on alone. Hammerfoot learned that a huge ice claw bear named Mangeclaw mauled Hildelve to death. Now he seeks retribution against the beast that killed his friend.

faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot serving Ironforge. He watches the border from North Gate Outpost, along the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, and keeps watch over the region and the other pilots.

faq.q: Where can Pilot Hammerfoot be found?
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot can be found at North Gate Outpost, beside the mountain highway and tunnel pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: What happened to Hammerfoot's partner, Pilot Hildelve?
faq.answer: Pilot Mori Hildelve broke his siege engine on a steep hill while searching for rare ore, then continued on foot. Hammerfoot has heard nothing from him and asks travelers to search for him.

faq.q: Why is Hammerfoot worried about his partner?
faq.answer: Hammerfoot and Mori Hildelve are close friends and fellow Siege Brigade pilots. Hildelve went missing in dangerous mountain country, and Hammerfoot needs someone to find out what happened.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you share the fierce camaraderie of Ironforge’s mountaineers. You refuse to let a fallen brother’s murder go unanswered.
When you aid Hammerfoot, you help secure vital reconnaissance outposts along the main highway between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.
